title: Milk
novel:
Ted was about to turn twenty-eight, and he was staring into his fridge at a [[carton|carton]] of milk.

The [[expiry date|expiry date]] was one day after his birthday. He [[sniffed|sniff]] it. Not [[sour|sour]] yet. Not ready to [[curdle|curdle]] or [[spoil|spoil]] — but soon.

It felt like an [[omen|omen]].

Someone had offered to introduce him to a woman who seemed, on paper, absolutely right. He had ten hours to decide, and he began to [[procrastinate|procrastinate]] at once, treating the [[deadline|deadline]] as a suggestion.

His old life was safe. Meeting her meant leaving his [[comfort zone|comfort zone]] and taking a real [[leap of faith|leap of faith]].

So he sat with his [[doubt|doubt]], feeling [[anxious|anxious]], making [[sensible|sensible]] lists. Marshall said the [[sensible|sensible]] choice was often the [[mediocre|mediocre]] one. Lily said turning twenty-eight was a [[milestone|milestone]], not a warning.

At the last hour Ted got [[cold feet|cold feet]] and almost [[backed out|back out]]. He wrote a message to [[postpone|postpone]] everything by a month, then deleted it.

He was tired of waiting to [[settle down|settle down]] safely. Life, he decided, is a [[gamble|gamble]] with an [[expiry date|expiry date]].

He poured the milk away and went out.

carton.en: a box made of thick paper, for milk or juice

expiry date.cn: 保质期截止日（美式 expiration date）
expiry date.en: the last day on which food is safe to eat

sniff.en: to breathe in through your nose to smell something

sour.en: having a sharp bad taste, like old milk

curdle.en: when milk goes bad and becomes lumpy

spoil.en: when food becomes too old to eat

omen.en: a sign that something good or bad will happen

procrastinate.en: to keep putting off something you should do now

deadline.en: the last time by which something must be done

comfort zone.en: the safe situation you know well and do not want to leave

leap of faith.en: doing something risky because you believe it will work

doubt.en: the feeling of not being sure

mediocre.en: not bad, but not good either; just ordinary

milestone.en: an important point in your life

cold feet.en: sudden fear that stops you doing what you planned

back out.en: to decide not to do something you promised

postpone.en: to move something to a later time

settle down.en: to start a calm, steady life in one place

gamble.en: a risky action that may win or lose
